HexKagune 1.3.2 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 55). Testing build: compiled and tested, not tried in game.

- One Eto per world: the Library generates once per world (a few hundred blocks from the centre of the map, in a plains, forest, taiga or savanna biome; /locate structure hexkagune:library finds it), and any second Eto is sent away. Killed, she comes back to her Library two in-game days later.
- Eto is smaller (about a head under a player) and has double the health (300) and more armour.
- Who you are to her changes everything: strangers, friends, her partner and her spouse each get their own greeting, topics and menu. Another player's partner gets a cold menu with lessons only, no gifts or flirting ("I'm Steve's. Don't get funny ideas").
- "Who are you?" is asked once. "Talk a while" opens topics (her books, her writing, her eye, the Library, herself, ghouls or humans, your day, how she feels, the night, the two of you, her past, rumours), each with replies of your own. Regard from talking is paid once a day per reply.
- Moods: happy, giddy, sulky, jealous, lonely, clingy, sleepy, hungry, wanting you at night, bored, wary. They change her lines, what she does with her hands, and how often she comes looking for you. The talk screen shows her mood.
- New ambient animations: reading a book, writing in a pocket book with a quill, sweeping with a brush (real items in her hands), playing with her hair, humming and swaying, looking around, a little dance, sulking, yawning, a hungry lick of the lips, clinging to your arm.
- Her partner: she keeps close, clings to you, greets you when you come home after a while, walks up to talk on her own, protects you if she sees something hurt you, and never fights back if you hit her (she sulks instead).
- Private alerts with a chime, only for her partner: when she wants a kiss, wants to talk, missed you, or is waiting for you at night.
- Hold a kiss long enough and she wraps her arms round your head and pulls you in (your view turns to her). Her feet stay on the ground when she kisses now.
- Her partner's "Be sweet to her" page: kiss, hug, hold me, sweet words (love you, missed you, dance with me, read to me...), come to bed (at night, a fade-to-black scene once a night with a buff in the morning), the ring, the surgery.
- Marriage: craft a Gold Ring (diamond on top, three gold ingots in a ring) and offer it while dating (after at least a day, regard 90+). The whole server is told. One partner each, for good: only killing her ends it.
- "Dating Steve" / "Married to Steve" shows over her head.
- Forgiveness: if she's cross with you or even hostile, bring a baby animal on a lead (a puppy, a kitten, a fox...) and right-click her; or give her a written book as a letter when she's ignoring you.
- Learning from her needs no relationship: any ghoul she talks to can take her lessons, and a lesson whose gate you already opened another way is never sent again (done quests stay done, here and everywhere in the journal).
- Her last lesson, "One Eye" (kill at night with your eye open, live through the brink), and for humans her pact (12 kills at night, a ghoul, its meat): finish them and she makes you one-eyed, coldly ("Why are you crying? Stop being a baby.") unless you're hers.
- Her fight: serious below 60% health (eye open, faster, resistance, Ukaku shard volleys, shorter cooldowns, harder hits), maniac below 30% (she laughs, shard storms, blitz chains, more resistance).
- Fixed: her spin no longer reverses at the end.
